summary: Colville NF lookout: 15-foot pole tower built 1938, replaced 1963 by a 20-foot tower, sold 1983 (cab went to a farmer's house); summit is now a drive-up spot.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The July 1937 newspaper item describes a plan for a 14-by-14 foot structure on a 20-foot tower. The register and Willhite describe the tower actually built in 1938 as a 15-foot pole tower. The plan and the build differed.

notes_for_editor: Record height_m 4.3 matches neither documented tower (15 ft is about 4.6 m; 20 ft is about 6.1 m). facts.height_m is set to 6.1 for the 1963 structure; the editor should confirm which structure the height field means. The abandonment is only dated 'late 1970s', so there is no abandoned event. No source states the access status, so facts.access is left unset. The 1933 survey route (Old Dominion Mine Road, via the washingtonlookouts page) differs from Willhite's route; both are in the story. Staff names come from the firelookout.com list and Colville Examiner items quoted on Willhite and washingtonlookouts pages. Record kind 'tower' is correct for the history, but the site has no tower now.
